turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
I use it correctly to get the best result?
If you mean using our wax melts with a warmer, start with 1–2 bears in an Outlet or Mini Mod Warmer, 2–3 bears in a Signature or Mod Warmer, or 5–8 bears in a Mod Max Warmer. You can mix scents, too!
Place an electric warmer somewhere safe, keep its cord away from edges and hot surfaces, then turn it on and set its timer if it has one. If it doesn’t, set a separate timer.
If you meant a particular warmer, tell me which one and I’ll tailor the guidance.
